note: Held-out set: 20 requests written before the rules were extended and never used to tune them.

items.text: Can you rename the Services tab to What We Do?
Please replace the banner photo with the sunset one.
Increase the size of the contact button.
Could you add an online store with Stripe checkout?
We need a podcast episode list page.
Please set up our newsletter with ConvertKit.
Can you translate the site into German?
Can you write our About text? We are struggling with the wording.
Forget the blog idea, we are good without it.
If there is money left over, a booking system would be great.
Out of curiosity, what would a members area cost?
Please use the pictures I attached in the gallery.
Could the portfolio show 25 pictures?
Please make the whole site load quickly on slow connections.
Please add our LinkedIn and YouTube icons to the footer.
Could you add meta descriptions to every page?
Maybe we could do a shop in phase two.
Can you also manage our Google Ads next month?
We would like monthly maintenance after the launch.
Can the contact form notify three email addresses?
